I am old now, and my back is not strong like before, but this small plot of maize is important for my household. I will put some cow dung on it because we have animals, and I will also try to get a little urea and DAP from the cooperative like the extension man advised, though I cannot carry much. I will plant the seed I saved from last year because I know it, and I do not have money for the new seed from the shop. I will not spray chemicals because maize does not need it, and there is no water for irrigation here. My grandchildren will help me with the weeding and harvesting, but I will need to hire a young man with oxen for one day to plough the field, and maybe one more day to help with planting.
